title: edgcpp vars
description: Configuration variables for the EDG C/C++ Compiler Frontend (edgcpp) component.

EDGCPP_VERSION.description: Specific version or semantic alias of edgcpp to install (e.g., '7.0.1', 'v7.0.1', '7.0', 'latest', or 'stable').

EDGCPP_FLAVOR.description: Release backend flavor of edgcpp to install ('edgcpp+llvm+gcc' for combined LLVM and GCC/C-generating backend support, 'edgcpp+llvm' for LLVM backend, or 'edgcpp+gcc' for GCC/C-generating backend).

EDGCPP_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Provisioning strategy for edgcpp ('libscript_native' downloads official GitHub release archives, 'from-source' compiles from source, 'local_binary' registers an existing cpfe binary, or 'pkg_mgr'/'system').

EDGCPP_PKG_MGR.description: Explicit package manager override for Mode 1 installation.

EDGCPP_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Bootstrap C/C++ compiler toolchain used when compiling edgcpp from source ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', or 'custom-cc').

EDGCPP_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Optional override URL for downloading an edgcpp binary or source archive.

EDGCPP_GIT_URL.description: Git repository URL used when building edgcpp from source via git.

EDGCPP_BIN.description: Filesystem path to an existing cpfe or edgcpp driver executable.

EDGCPP_BACKEND_CC.description: Underlying C compiler/assembler/linker invoked after EDG front-end processing ('gcc', 'clang', 'cl', or 'cc').

EDGCPP_BACKEND_CXX.description: Underlying C++ compiler/linker invoked after EDG C++ front-end processing ('g++', 'clang++', 'cl', or 'c++').

EDGCPP_EXTRA_CFLAGS.description: Additional C compiler flags appended by the edgcpp driver wrapper.

EDGCPP_EXTRA_CXXFLAGS.description: Additional C++ compiler flags appended by the edg-c++ driver wrapper.

EDGCPP_STRIP_GNU_FLAGS.description: Whether the edgcpp wrapper strips backend-only GNU/Clang machine and optimizer flags before passing arguments to cpfe.

EDGCPP_FALLBACK_ON_ERROR.description: Whether edgcpp_wrapper should fallback to EDGCPP_BACKEND_CC when a translation unit uses unsupported target-specific extensions while recording telemetry.

EDGCPP_LOG_FILE.description: Path to the JSONL compilation telemetry log file written by edgcpp_wrapper.
